# Legal and provenance policy

Chimera II separates source code, metadata and executable redistribution.

1. Open-source software is included only under a license compatible with its redistribution and with its license notices preserved.
2. Proprietary applications are represented by manifests, official URLs or store adapters rather than copied binaries unless redistribution is expressly authorized.
3. Store adapters do not bypass authentication, signing, DRM, entitlement or platform security.
4. Apple App Store applications remain subject to Apple's signing/distribution controls.
5. Microsoft Store integration uses supported MSIX/AppX or EXE/MSI distribution paths.
6. Android images preserve AVB, rollback and vendor security requirements; signing keys are never committed.
